epbcs.plan.label: project_code
epbcs.plan.description: Capital project code. Discrete large projects are C<yy>B<nnn>_<nnn> (C23B225_690); blankets and programs are CZZF<n>_<nnn>.

epbcs.plan.label: fiscal_year
epbcs.plan.description: Fiscal year. Northline's fiscal year is the calendar year; FY26 is January to December 2026.

epbcs.plan.label: plan_vintage
epbcs.plan.description: Working, Jan Calendarization or MTP. Working is the live plan; MTP is the mid-term plan adopted each September.

epbcs.plan.label: utility_code
epbcs.plan.description: ARD, BEL, COR, DUN or SSD. The utility that owns the project.

epbcs.plan.label: budget_category
epbcs.plan.description: Plant large projects, PFAS, Network blankets, Lead Capex, Network common projects or Overhead.

epbcs.plan.label: approved_budget_usd
epbcs.plan.description: Lifetime approved budget (Active Budget Plan) after WIN authorizations and transfers. Zero for projects not yet approved.

epbcs.plan.label: plan_amount_usd
epbcs.plan.description: Planned spend in this fiscal year in this vintage.

epbcs.plan.label: contingency_usd
epbcs.plan.description: Contingency held inside the approved budget at authorization.

epbcs.plan.label: as_of_date
epbcs.plan.description: Date the vintage was taken from EPBCS.

epbcs.forecast.label: project_code
epbcs.forecast.description: Capital project code, as on epbcs.plan.

epbcs.forecast.label: forecast_date
epbcs.forecast.description: Date the working forecast was taken. Forecasts land on the 15th of each month; a project office can reload late.

epbcs.forecast.label: forecast_round
epbcs.forecast.description: Monthly, or a formal round: 3+9, 6+6, 9+3 (months of actuals plus months of forecast).

epbcs.forecast.label: actuals_through
epbcs.forecast.description: Last day of posted actuals the forecast starts from.

epbcs.forecast.label: actuals_to_date_usd
epbcs.forecast.description: Inception-to-date posted actuals the forecast starts from.

epbcs.forecast.label: committed_usd
epbcs.forecast.description: Remaining committed work: open contracts and orders not yet invoiced.

epbcs.forecast.label: contingency_usd
epbcs.forecast.description: Contingency held separately and not yet drawn.

epbcs.forecast.label: forecast_at_completion_usd
epbcs.forecast.description: Actuals to date + committed + uncommitted + contingency. The figure compared with the approved budget.

epbcs.forecast.label: submitted_by
epbcs.forecast.description: Project manager who submitted the forecast.

epbcs.monthly_spread.label: period
epbcs.monthly_spread.description: Month of the fiscal year, 1 to 12.

epbcs.monthly_spread.label: forecast_usd
epbcs.monthly_spread.description: Working forecast for the month; posted actuals replace it once the month closes.

gl.project_costing_line.label: project_code
gl.project_costing_line.description: Capital project the line is charged to. Null on 0.4% of lines (unallocated, kept apart rather than attributed).

gl.project_costing_line.label: journal_source
gl.project_costing_line.description: AP, PAYROLL, ACCRUAL, AFUDC or TRANSFER.

gl.project_costing_line.label: amount_usd
gl.project_costing_line.description: Posted cost in USD. Reversals carry negative amounts.

gl.project_costing_line.label: vendor_id
gl.project_costing_line.description: Vendor on AP lines; null on payroll and allocations.

gl.project_costing_line.label: utility_code
gl.project_costing_line.description: Utility of the business unit that posted the line.

commitments.po_line.label: contract_no
commitments.po_line.description: Contract the order releases against (QDN-2025-C01). Null on stand-alone orders.

commitments.po_line.label: framework_agreement_no
commitments.po_line.description: Framework agreement the line was ordered under (FA-2025-PIPE-01). Null when ordered off-framework.

commitments.po_line.label: quantity
commitments.po_line.description: Quantity ordered, in the catalogue unit.

commitments.po_line.label: unit_price_usd
commitments.po_line.description: Price per unit on the order.

commitments.po_line.label: confirmation_status
commitments.po_line.description: Unconfirmed, Confirmed by supplier, Shipped or Received.

commitments.po_line.label: ordered_on
commitments.po_line.description: Date the order line was raised.

commitments.po_line.label: open_usd
commitments.po_line.description: Ordered minus received minus cancelled. Unpaid invoices are not open commitment.

commitments.po_line.label: promised_date
commitments.po_line.description: Vendor promised date; can lag what the contractor writes in mail.

commitments.win_authorization.label: request_type
commitments.win_authorization.description: Original authorization, Budget revision or Transfer.

commitments.win_authorization.label: approval_level
commitments.win_authorization.description: Level 01 to Level 04. Level 03 is the SVP Capital Delivery, for changes above $1M.

commitments.win_authorization.label: amount_usd
commitments.win_authorization.description: Amount requested; for a revision, the change to the approved budget.

commitments.win_authorization.label: reason
commitments.win_authorization.description: Free-text reason given by the requester.

commitments.framework_agreement.label: category
commitments.framework_agreement.description: Ductile iron pipe and fittings, Valves and hydrants, Meters, GAC media, Pumps and motors, Electrical, Chemicals.

commitments.framework_agreement.label: framework_unit_price_usd
commitments.framework_agreement.description: Agreed price per unit, before the annual index adjustment.

commitments.framework_agreement.label: lead_time_weeks
commitments.framework_agreement.description: Lead time the supplier currently confirms.

commitments.savings_register.label: category
commitments.savings_register.description: Procurement category the saving is in.

commitments.savings_register.label: lever
commitments.savings_register.description: Framework compliance, Renegotiation, Re-bid, Specification change or Volume consolidation.

commitments.savings_register.label: savings_usd
commitments.savings_register.description: Saving secured against the price that would otherwise have been paid.

commitments.savings_register.label: secured_on
commitments.savings_register.description: Date the saving was secured (order placed or contract signed).

assets.cwip_balance.label: cwip_usd
assets.cwip_balance.description: Open CWIP balance at period end.

assets.cwip_balance.label: afudc_ytd_usd
assets.cwip_balance.description: AFUDC accrued in the fiscal year to date.

assets.cwip_balance.label: first_charge_date
assets.cwip_balance.description: Date of the first charge; CWIP age is measured from it.

assets.plant_in_service.label: project_code
assets.plant_in_service.description: Capital project the asset came from.

assets.plant_in_service.label: utility_code
assets.plant_in_service.description: Utility whose books carry the asset.

assets.plant_in_service.label: plant_class
assets.plant_in_service.description: Source of supply and pumping, Water treatment, Transmission and distribution mains, Services meters and hydrants, or General plant.

assets.plant_in_service.label: in_service_date
assets.plant_in_service.description: Date the asset was placed in service (used and useful).

assets.plant_in_service.label: amount_usd
assets.plant_in_service.description: Cost moved from CWIP to plant.

assets.plant_in_service.label: unitized
assets.plant_in_service.description: True once Plant Accounting has unitized the asset.

assets.plant_in_service.label: retired_on
assets.plant_in_service.description: Date the asset was retired. Null while in service.

assets.depreciation_reserve.label: asset_id
assets.depreciation_reserve.description: Fixed asset number, as on assets.plant_in_service.

assets.depreciation_reserve.label: plant_class
assets.depreciation_reserve.description: Plant class the depreciation rate belongs to.

assets.depreciation_reserve.label: depreciation_rate
assets.depreciation_reserve.description: Annual rate applied. Rates are the ones the last rate order approved until a new depreciation study is approved.

assets.rate_base_component.label: component
assets.rate_base_component.description: Contributions in aid of construction (net), Accumulated deferred income taxes, Customer advances, Cash working capital, or Materials and supplies.

assets.rate_base_component.label: amount_usd
assets.rate_base_component.description: Balance at period end. Deductions are carried as positive amounts and subtracted.

assets.rate_base_component.label: treatment
assets.rate_base_component.description: Deduct or Add, as the last rate order treated it.

pmo.project.label: project_code
pmo.project.description: Capital project code, the key every other table joins on.

pmo.project.label: project_name
pmo.project.description: Project name (Dunmoor East Filter Media Renewal).

pmo.project.label: utility_code
pmo.project.description: ARD, BEL, COR, DUN or SSD.

pmo.project.label: region
pmo.project.description: Northvale, Eastmoor, Cascadia or Lakeshore Region.

pmo.project.label: program
pmo.project.description: Program the project belongs to (Federal PFAS Program, Lead Program, Treatment Renewal).

pmo.project.label: budget_category
pmo.project.description: Plant large projects, PFAS, Network blankets, Lead Capex, Network common projects or Overhead.

pmo.project.label: phase
pmo.project.description: In Planning, In Development, In Delivery or Closed.

pmo.project.label: large_project
pmo.project.description: True for discrete projects with an approved budget of $5M or more.

pmo.project.label: compliance_driver
pmo.project.description: PFAS rule, Lead and Copper Rule Improvements, Consent order or None.

pmo.project.label: rate_case_eligible
pmo.project.description: True when the project can be claimed in a rate case.

pmo.project.label: cost_tool
pmo.project.description: Project controls tool the forecast comes from. Lakeshore moved to a new tool in June 2026.

pmo.utility.label: utility_code
pmo.utility.description: ARD, BEL, COR, DUN or SSD.

pmo.utility.label: utility_name
pmo.utility.description: Northline Water of Ardenia, of Belmara, of Corvale, of Dunmoor, or Shared Services Division.

pmo.utility.label: state
pmo.utility.description: State the utility is regulated in.

pmo.contract.label: contract_type
pmo.contract.description: Construction, Engineering, Construction management, Supply or Term agreement.

pmo.change_order.label: co_number
pmo.change_order.description: Change order number within the contract (CO-003).

pmo.change_order.label: cost_impact_usd
pmo.change_order.description: Change to contract value. Requested changes are not approved budget.

pmo.change_order.label: time_impact_days
pmo.change_order.description: Change to contract time, in days.

pmo.change_order.label: reason_category
pmo.change_order.description: Differing site condition, Owner scope change, Design error or Regulatory.

pmo.rate_case_claim.label: test_year_end
pmo.rate_case_claim.description: End of the test year the claim falls in.

pmo.rate_case_claim.label: rate_base_usd
pmo.rate_case_claim.description: Rate base the project adds if in service in time.

upload.inservice.description: Project code as typed in the file. 260 rows name codes that do not exist in pmo.project.

upload.inservice.description: In-service date the project manager now expects.

upload.inservice.description: True when the code exists in pmo.project.
